title: On Evaluating LLM Alignment by Evaluating LLMs as Judges

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the rankings produced by a specific LLM evaluator (e.g., GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) against a gold standard to observe if the LLM disproportionately favors its own generated outputs or those from its own model family.

Evaluating LLM-as-judge consistency by swapping the presentation order of the two outputs in pairwise comparison prompts and identifying/filtering instances where the model's preference changes solely based on the order.

Using length-controlled (e.g., AlpacaEval-LC) and style-controlled (e.g., Arena-Hard-SC, ChatBot Arena style-controlled) rankings to evaluate models while mitigating human or LLM-judge preferences for specific formatting styles or longer response lengths.
